sop_thesis: **Genasys (GNSS)** operates in Consumer Staples (Consumer Electronics/Appliances) with an established market capitalization of $58.91M. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Everyday Household Brand Trust, Shelf Space Dominance & Global Supply Scale. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $1.52 (17.8% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $1.26 (Tranche 1), $1.19 (Tranche 2), and $1.1 (Tranche 3).
